verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap documents only asynchronous transcription of prerecorded files, submitted by URL or upload. Its SSE option streams the progress and transcript segments of an already-submitted file job; it does not accept live audio input over a WebSocket or streaming endpoint. This is an adjacent output-streaming feature, not real-time live-audio transcription.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: When enabled, streams progress and chronological transcription segments using SSE.
Transcribes prerecorded audio and video files through an API.
